explanation: The value is 0 at every D1 and GO step, and also at D2 unless the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by the common transition; in that case it is about 9-10 when a2 has been the agent steady choice for several trials (10 if the previous trial was rewarded, 9 if not), dropping to about 6-8 later in the episode (after trial ~45). It is weak (0-3) on the first a2 trial after switching over from a1, or right after a run of rare or unrewarded trials, and it is always 0 when the agent reaches S1, when it chooses a1, and on rare transitions.
